worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.summary: Draw a signal corridor along the aim: every enemy in the corridor is struck once for special damage and may be jammed into confusion. A jammed target can fumble its actions, and taking another hit lets the scrambled signal bite back.
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.use.0: Pin several enemies lined up in one sweep
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.use.1: Seal a corridor with a wide band
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.use.2: Switch to Pulse for a heavier hit on one target
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.description: Each enemy in the corridor takes %1$s special damage; the corridor is %2$s blocks half-wide and %3$s blocks long, and the drawn band is the hit area.
On being lit, %1$s chance to jam the target into confusion for %2$s; each action it starts then has %3$s chance to be broken.
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.pulse.on: Pulse: a narrower corridor with a heavier hit and a higher jam chance, at the cost of shorter reach - good for singling one target out.
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.pulse.off: Continuous: a wider, longer corridor that can catch several at once, at the cost of a lighter hit and a lower jam chance.
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the beam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.growth.1: From level %1$s the beam power rises to %2$s and the jam chance to %3$s.
On: a narrower corridor with x1.15 hit and x1.3 jam chance, but x0.88 reach - good for one target. Off (Continuous): a wider, longer corridor that catches more at once, with a base hit and jam chance.
Beyond this distance it closes in first; higher means it sweeps earlier.
On: a target with other enemies around it ranks higher, since a wide corridor catches several; off: normal ranged-attack ordering.
On: lower-health targets rank higher for the finishing hit; off: all targets rank alike.
